items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: That was Bebe Matthews. Bill Matthews, brother.

ctx.x: What did you remember? He played drums and trombone on them. Trombone, Celestine. Yeah, but he played drums, too, one time. That was Bebe Matthews. Bill Matthews, brother. Oh, yeah. Oh, Kid Ora, did you ever work with him? Oh, Kid Ora, I never did. I worked with him, you know, but I never was a member of the band. I worked with him. We'd work together, you know, and I'd play in the dance, where they'd have two bands. We'd catch each other on the corner, you know, advertising, and we'd play against each other, you…
